content: Human-labeling session — def-surprise-flank-react:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, intel reports the enemy will attack from the NORTH. Terrain agrees — the north edge is a rocky band with a single narrow opening, already covered by two pre-built pillboxes (stationary defensive turrets). Your Construction Yard sits at (20,20) and starts at 50% HP. Four rifle defenders are distributed around the yard on hold-fire orders — they will NOT shoot, even if the enemy walks under their guns. Win bar: four kills, two own units alive, yard standing, within about fifty turns.
